name: Lightsaber parasol
description: The lightsaber parasol was a Sith lightsaber created by Kouru, a female Sith who led a bandit group. It functioned as a singled-bladed lightsaber when she used only the lightsaber hilt. With its attached parasol auxiliary, it produced multiple red plasma blades in a manner that resembled a parasol, particularly when she spun it to create a shield.

data.name: Lightsaber parasol
data.creator: Kouru
data.design: Constructed according to a blueprint created by the Ronin
